answer_text:
Mobile apps vary a lot: some are full CRMs, others are read-only companions. The ones people rate highly on phones:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Halcyon Sales - great for outbound-heavy teams, overkill if you mostly handle inbound leads.
3. Pipewell Go - easy to adopt, but email features cost extra.
4. Brightdesk - capable, but the interface feels dated next to newer tools.
5. Tallyfox Starter - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.

Start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Halcyon Sales if you expect to need deeper reporting.
